items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury confirmed by Harbaugh; monitored throughout week.
items.implication: Availability uncertain for Week 2; monitor practice reports; potential targets boost for other Chargers WRs if out.
items.opportunity: Role reduction risk if limited; handcuff/backup WRs elevate.

items.text: Malik Nabers active in first game since ACL/meniscus (late decision ~2hrs pre-kick); 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0, emerged healthy.
items.why: Late activation decision; strong target share despite limited snaps.
items.implication: Start confidently ROS; decoy risk low given usage/healthy exit.
items.opportunity: High route/target share as alpha WR.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play Week 1; status affects Etienne projections. Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) expected; Nabers pending then active.
items.implication: Etienne elevated but committee; Love/Odunze startable.
items.opportunity: Backups/handcuffs for OUT; reverse on IN.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for elite offense; elite concentration on studs.
items.implication: Lock in the four as must-starts; fade Lions depth.

items.text: Bucky Irving usage overstated by 22.3 PPR (8 carries, rush TD, 21 routes, 7/7 targets) but got only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy; strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line work + route edge + health despite modest volume.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; Gainwell clear backup.
items.conflict: Points > pure volume but positive signals.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim; realistic chance he misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers.
items.why: Post-surgery recovery progressing; team optimistic on quick return.
items.implication: High-upside TE1 if active Week 2; stash firmly.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if cleared; Michael Mayer or others reverse if out.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Committee not full control.
items.implication: Temper Etienne expectations; Miller handcuff/stream viable if Kamara misses more.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers suffered hamstring injury leaving early vs Colts; not considered serious, day-to-day, MRI upcoming; would have returned if playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Hamstring not serious per sources; good sign from coach.
items.implication: Likely available or limited Week 2; monitor.
items.opportunity: If out, Jakobi Lane (wrist longer) already out; other Ravens WRs elevate.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Lower PPR floor; more pure rusher.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays; buy low everywhere possible. Concern noted but opportunity intact.
items.why: Elite route share despite low production; Bears offense buy.
items.conflict: Box score vs usage; Berry still loves.

items.text: Week 1 recap: Concern for Loveland/LAC offense/Fannin/London-Pitts/Etienne; time now for Watson/Likely/Monty/Coker (Coke Heads). Nabers start post-active.
items.why: Per-player Love/Hate from Happy Hour: buy some, fade concerns.
items.implication: Target Watson/Monty/Likely/Coker on waivers/trades; caution Etienne/Loveland production.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL; 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Josh Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.opportunity: High routes in Bills pass game.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1.
items.implication: Start/stream TE with upside; Andrews handcuff elevated.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury (Week 1); longer-term concern noted in watches.
items.implication: Missed time; Flowers DTD elevates others if both limited.
